scope: 36 ordered sampled PNGs for coast and fleet in phone and fallback tiers.
verdict: Keep the compact tree contact shadows. They ground foliage more cleanly across both coast tiers, while all fleet PNGs are identical to the lossless sample set.
remaining: Cyan player circle and separate runway circle still appear together.
The Hawk collisions at coast 180 and fleet 120 remain present in this packet.
